items.title: Multiplicativity of the total Chern class in a short exact sequence

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the multiplicativity of the total Chern class in a short exact sequence of finite locally free sheaves, c(E) = c(E_1) c(E_2) (statement lines 7964-7987, tag 02UI). The proof reduces to an integral base, then runs an induction on the rank of the submodule: it passes to the projective bundle of the submodule, where the pulled back submodule acquires an invertible quotient, applies the induction hypothesis to the two resulting exact sequences, and descends the resulting identity using injectivity of pullback along the bundle and the identification of the fundamental class of the bundle with the pullback of the class of the base. The induction with its passage to the projective bundle is the substance, so the claim is H2.
